# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Apr 21, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on hardening transaction types, fixing critical bugs in L2 fork tests and interopgen, and stabilizing CI/acceptance tests. Significant progress was made in Kona's proof system and Supernode interop behavior, alongside extensive interop test migration and new documentation on transaction finality.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Core Protocol Enhancements & Bug Fixes
A new feature was added to `op-alloy` to harden the post-execution (0x7D) transaction type, including renaming `sdm` to `post_exec` for infrastructure libraries and arbitrary implementation pins [#20185](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20185). Critical fixes were implemented for L2 fork tests to correctly deduct intrinsic gas during bundle execution [#20075](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20075) and for `interopgen` to use `InteropOffset` when setting Interop genesis flags, resolving `L2Genesis_InvalidInteropConfig` errors [#20148](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20148).

### Kona & Supernode Stability Improvements
Several fixes addressed stability and correctness in Kona and Supernode. This included resolving an unbounded memory growth issue in `PipelineCursor` by evicting `origin_infos` entries [#20165](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20165), fixing incorrect L2 account proof hinting by sending block hashes instead of numbers [#20163](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20163), and unbreaking the `kona-host-client-offline-cannon` CI job by updating the MIPS64 target spec [#20167](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20167). The `op-supernode` also received a fix to prevent cross-safe and finalized heads from stalling pre-interop when interop is scheduled [#20215](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20215).

### CI & Acceptance Test Reliability
Efforts were made to improve the reliability of CI and acceptance tests. This involved retrying `StartSequencer` in `op-devstack` on stale unsafe heads to prevent RPC rejections [#20204](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20204), updating CircleCI configuration to fix a parameter typo and simplify job definitions [#20202](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20202), and stabilizing `TestReorgUnsafeHead` by replacing `time.Sleep` with deterministic polling [#20201](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20201). Extensive interop acceptance tests were unskipped and migrated to Supernode presets [#20136](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20136), and a new interop activation boundary fault proof test was added [#20123](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20123).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Documentation & CI Alignment:** A new guide for writing acceptance tests was added [#20225](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20225), and CI checks were proposed to align `op-deployer` ABI with contracts ABI [#20223](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20223).
- **Feature & Fork Enhancements:** New features include a Karst fork action test [#20220](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20220), a zk Go deployer [#20219](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20219), and a post-exec block executor and SDM warming inspector for `alloy-op-evm` [#20213](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20213). Contracts will also enforce the EIP-7825 gas cap in NUT bundle validation [#20205](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20205).
- **Stability & Testing:** Fixes are in progress for `op-supernode` to close the interop activation gap in verified-head [#20221](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20221) and guard chain container VN against torn interface reads [#20211](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20211). `op-devstack` will retry on transient `SyncStatus` RPC errors [#20209](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20209), and `op-acceptance-tests` will verify deposits bypass the EIP-7825 tx gas limit cap [#20222](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20222), wait for EL to adopt conflicting blocks [#20206](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20206), and stabilize `TestUnsafeGapFillAfterUnsafeReorg_RestartL2CL` [#20199](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20199).
- **Tooling & CI Refinements:** Rust toolchain installation is being consolidated into `mise.toml` [#20207](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20207), and `cargo-*` tools and `lychee` are also moving from CI installers to `mise.toml` [#20210](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20210).

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Interoperability & Supernode Stability
Several issues related to interop and Supernode stability were resolved. This includes the `op-supernode` cross-safe and finalized heads stalling pre-interop when interop is scheduled [#20191](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20191), and the `interopgen` forcing Interop at genesis in delayed setups [#20079](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20079). The issue of conditional deployment of `CrossL2Inbox` in `kona-node` and interop was also closed [#19311](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19311).

### Audit Findings & Gas Deduction
Two audit findings were addressed and closed. The `ExecuteNUTBundle` overstating available gas for deposit transactions was fixed [#20076](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20076), and the `interopgen` issue mentioned above was also a result of an audit finding.

### Kona Proof System & Monorepo Migration
The `kona` output root mismatch after deposit-only block replacement during message expiry consolidation was resolved [#19848](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19848). Additionally, the tracking issue for migrating Rust crates to the monorepo was closed, indicating completion of this significant refactoring effort [#18927](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18927).

### Deprecation & Feature Flags
The question of whether `op-reth` is mandatory was closed, clarifying that `op-geth` can still be used until May 31st [#20203](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20203). Feature flags for `OPSuccinct` in contracts were also completed and closed [#18419](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18419, [#18420](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18420).

## NEW ISSUES

### Flaky Tests & CI Instability
New flaky tests have been identified, including `TestReorgUnsafeHead` [#20198](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20198) and `TestSequencingWindowExpiry` [#20212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20212), indicating ongoing challenges with CI stability.

### Conductor & SDM Enhancements
New issues propose enhancing `op-conductor` to support reorgs to prevent chain stalls [#20214](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20214). For SDM, there are plans to move PoC2 functionality into `develop` [#20216](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20216) and review how to allow for multiple policies [#20218](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20218).

### Deposit Handling & Hardfork Overrides
An issue was opened to implement and test deposit handling with the EIP-7825 limit, ensuring `OptimismPortal2` does not revert and derivation transactions bypass the cap [#20217](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20217). Additionally, `op-reth` is reported to be missing hardfork override flags, causing superchain nodes to fail p2p connections when the registry lacks timestamps [#20224](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20224).
